summary: Normalize qualified CLI agent IDs and support helper inherit-launcher bindings (Q411)

replay.detail: No historical agent subjects are renamed or rewritten.

schema.detail: Launcher authority uses existing owner-local observation storage; no schema migration is required. Server-written action receipts contain attribution labels, not absolute credential-directory references or authority.

rules.detail: Helpers launched from an observed launcher runtime are lifetime-bound to its exact incarnation. Credential inheritance requires Linux SO_PEERPIDFD (kernel 6.5 or newer) and kernel socket peer ancestry to the daemon-recorded launcher harness PID and Linux process-start token, never an environment identity. There is no PID-only or start-token fallback. The connector witness is checked before and after ancestry traversal, so a surviving inherited socket cannot preserve an exited connector's authority. Missing kernel witnesses, unavailable provenance and non-Linux ancestry fail closed; ordinary non-inheriting authentication is unchanged. Old launcher runs must be relaunched. Agent identities without runtime observations retain ordinary non-inheriting creation. Claude/Codex helpers must match the launcher's credential-bearing harness. Owner-local bindings ignore peer authority and record durable server-only launch attribution.

compatibility.detail: agents new and lifecycle commands normalize bare and agent/-qualified subjects exactly once; short names retain host scoping. New server-only client.action-result receipts replay normally. Keys with legacy custom.client.action-result receipts fail closed before dispatch with legacy-action-receipt-untrusted, regardless of actor; inspect the original outcome before choosing another key. No claims are rewritten.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime or live migration is required.

manual.detail: No manual migration is required. Use the created subject returned by the CLI for later commands.

recovery.detail: Helper associations bind the launcher's exact runtime incarnation, not a later replacement. Peer client.action-result receipts are rejected before projection so they cannot occupy local action receipt CAS subjects.
